parts:
Hi,

You should move u to parameters block and pay attention to dnorm(mean, tau) in BUGS but normal(mean, stddev) in Stan. So, you can rewrite your model as:

data {
  int<lower=0> N;
  int y[N];
}

parameters {
  real b0;
  real b;
  real phi;
vector[N] u;

}

transformed parameters {
  vector[N] mu;
  vector[N] a;

a[1] <- phi + u[1];
  mu[1] <- exp(b0 + a[1]);

for (i in 2:N) {
    mu[i] <- exp(b0 + log(i)*b + a[i]);
    a[i] <- phi*a[i-1] + u[i];
  }
}

model {
  u ~ normal(0, 1);

b0 ~ normal(0, 10);
  b ~ normal(0, 10);
  phi ~ normal(0, 10);
  y ~ poisson(mu);
}

-Bee

messages.subject: Re: I want to rewrite my openbugs code into the rstan but it failed
parts:
I'm sorry that I didn't check my code. You have to move a[i] before mu[i], because the line order is important in Stan.

I confirmed the following code works:

data {
  int<lower=0> N;
  int y[N];
}

parameters {
  real b0;
  real b;
  real phi;
vector[N] u;

}

transformed parameters {
  vector[N] mu;
  vector[N] a;
a[1] <- phi + u[1];
mu[1] <- exp(b0 + a[1]);
for (i in 2:N) {

a[i] <- phi*a[i-1] + u[i];
    mu[i] <- exp(b0 + log(i)*b + a[i]);
  }
}

model {
  u ~ normal(0, 1);
  b0 ~ normal(0, 10);
  b ~ normal(0, 10);
  phi ~ normal(0, 10);
  y ~ poisson(mu);
}
-Bee

parts:
Also, you really want to avoid exp. We have a log-scale
parameterized poisson, with which you can replace
> mu[i] <- exp(b0+log(i)*b+a[i]);

> ...
> y ~ poisson(mu);


with

log_mu[i] <- b0 + log(i) * b + a[i];

y ~ poisson_log(log_mu);

It's faster and more stable.

- Bob
